# sendgrid_open_tracking_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide open tracking setting. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one open tracking configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_open_tracking_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether open tracking is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `open_tracking_settings`.
